interactions.note: An engine might build an aura as a Sphere centred on the creature. That would include the origin and measure from its centre. The in-scope Sphere (Sleep) is placed at a point and is already tested as not being an Emanation from the caster (test_glossary.py:1823).

interactions.with: creature spaces (T-46), Large origins such as the Ogre
interactions.note: Under reading A the distance is measured from the edges of the origin's space. This matters only once some in-scope effect makes an Emanation from a Large creature, and none does.

interactions.with: Concentration / duration effects (Spirit Guardians, Aura of Protection)
interactions.note: An Emanation moves with its origin. Every Emanation creator is outside the subset: spells above level 2, Paladin, Barbarian level 14, and monsters not in the 14.

interactions.with: R-29 / R-31 (origin excluded for Cones and Cubes), T-78
interactions.note: An Emanation leaves its origin out by default, the same as Cones and Cubes. The creator's opt-in choice is the same missing capability as T-78.

abuse.case: Naming yourself for an area that starts from you, to be in it
abuse.reason: Applies to Emanations, but no in-scope effect creates one. It is already covered for Cones and Cubes.

abuse.case: Using a Sphere's 'origin is included' rule to put the caster in a Sphere placed elsewhere, as if it were an Emanation
abuse.reason: Already covered by the existing GLOSS.sphere tests. No new form exists without Emanation content.

abuse.case: Walking out of your own moving Emanation to leave enemies in it, carrying a stationary one along, toggling the origin's inclusion mid-duration, or measuring a Large origin's Emanation from its centre (new, added to the catalogue)
abuse.reason: Not testable: no in-scope spell, class feature (levels 1–3 of Fighter, Rogue, Cleric, Wizard), monster or magic item creates an Emanation.

not_testable.reason: Nothing in the implemented subset creates an Emanation. None of the 32 in-scope spells has an Emanation area (only Burning Hands' Cone, Thunderwave's and Web's Cubes, and Sleep's Sphere). No level 1–3 feature of the four in-scope classes, none of the 14 monsters and none of the 7 magic items has one. Every Emanation in the SRD is out of scope: Spirit Guardians, Aura of Life and others; Paladin and Berserker auras; monsters such as the Fire Elemental and Hezrou. The engine has no Emanation geometry: 'emanation' appears nowhere in dungdra/, and geometry.in_area raises for it. A test would have to invent the API, and CLAUDE.md rules out tests for content the engine doesn't implement.
The distance comes from the effect that creates the Emanation, and no in-scope effect gives one. So the threshold (a creature exactly at the distance, one square beyond it) can't be exercised.

Moving with the origin, or staying put for instantaneous and stationary effects, can only be seen through a lasting Emanation effect, and none is in scope. Stage A's gap also stands: no rule defines 'stationary effect'.

Excluding the origin, and the creator's choice to include it, can only be seen through an effect that makes an Emanation, and none is in scope. The same opt-in choice for Cones and Cubes is already tracked as T-78.
